content:
Apple's flagship store at The Oracle shopping centre in Reading, UK, will move to a newly designed location in December to continue trading.

Before then, the Apple Festival Place store in Basingstoke will close in November, bringing the total number of Apple retail stores in the UK down to 38…

Apple said the renovated Oracle store will offer all the amenities customers expect from its latest designs.

We are excited to reopen the completely redesigned Apple The Oracle this December, bringing residents of south-east England a new way to explore and purchase the latest Apple products, as well as to receive support for their existing devices. The brand-new Apple The Oracle will feature Experience Rooms where customers can try out products, a dedicated Genius Bar, and an Apple Pickup area for collecting online orders, along with free Today at Apple sessions teaching customers how to get the most out of their favourite devices.

The store first opened its doors in June 2011. Ahead of the reopening, Apple will first shutter its Basingstoke branch.

To make way for this upgrade project, we have decided to close the Apple Festival Place store. Apple Festival Place will remain open until November 2026, after which all staff will be given the opportunity to transfer to Apple The Oracle or another Apple Store location. It has been our pleasure serving the Basingstoke community for the past 15 years, and we look forward to continuing to welcome customers at nearby Apple Stores, as well as via Apple.com, the Apple Store app, and Apple Authorised Resellers and Service Providers across south-east England.

That store has also been operating since 2011.

Over the past 18 months, Apple has refurbished its stores on London's Regent Street and at the Lakeside shopping centre in Essex. Stores in Birmingham and Southampton are also currently undergoing upgrades.

Over the past 18 months, Apple has opened 11 new stores worldwide and relocated 17 stores to newly designed locations, including Apple Miami Worldcenter and Apple Downtown Detroit.
